---
title: "effect size correlation"
---


```{r}
#| label: load-packages
#| echo: false

pacman::p_load(rstatix, colorspace, geomtextpath, ggtext, install = FALSE)

```


## Introduction

Compute the correlation between effect sizes of different dementia categories at a series of p value cutoffs.

## Load the data

### Correlation data

```{r}
cor_series <- read_rds(here("data/publicly_available/correlation_among_demcats_various_pval_cutoffs_stable_mci_lump.rds")) |>
  filter(cor_method == "spearman") |> 
  rename(pval_cutoff = pval_cutoffs)

glimpse(cor_series)
```

## Visualize the correlation

### Initialize a list to store the line plots

```{r}

# For main figures
line_plot_ES_corr_main <- list()
# For supplementary figures
line_plot_ES_corr_suppl <- list()
```

### Altogether

Make line plots for the correlation along p value cutoffs, color the line by the second category, facet by the first category.


```{r}
cor_series |>
  mutate(pval_cutoff = as.numeric(pval_cutoff)) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = pval_cutoff, y = cor, color = demcat2)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  labs(
    title = "Correlation between categories",
    x = "P value cutoff",
    y = "Spearman correlation") +
  facet_wrap(~demcat1) #+
  # theme_minimal()
```

### Make a data preparation function

This function prepares the data for the line plot.

```{r}
#| output: false

# Create a function to prepare the data for the line plot
prepare_data_for_line_plot <- function(.data, demcat_base, demcat_other) {
  .data |>
    mutate(pval_cutoff = as.numeric(pval_cutoff)) |> 
    filter(demcat1 %in% c(demcat_base, demcat_other), ! demcat2  %in% c(demcat_base, demcat_other)) |>
    # Set normal2incid as the first category for demcat2
    mutate(demcat2 = fct_relevel(demcat2, "prev", "normal2incid", "mci2incid")) |>
    # Create a group column
    mutate(line_group = glue("{demcat2} vs. {demcat1}")) |>
    arrange(demcat2, desc(demcat1)) |>
    # Set the order of the line_group
    mutate(line_group = fct_inorder(line_group)) #|> 
}

# Test the function
cor_series |>
  prepare_data_for_line_plot("normal2mci", "prev") |> 
  count(demcat1, demcat2, line_group) 

```


### Make a plotting function

This function makes a line plot with text along the line.

```{r}
#| output: false

# Make a demcat tibble
demcat_against <- tibble(
  demcat = c("<span style='font-size:6pt'> vs. </span> normal2mci", "<span style='font-size:6pt'> vs. </span> prev"),
  x = c(5, 5),
  y = c(-0.1, 0.1)
)

# Create a function to make a line plot with text along the line
make_line_plot_with_text <- function(.data, path_text_size = 3, demcat_text_size = 8, ...) {
  .data |>
    ggplot(aes(x = pval_cutoff, y = cor, color = demcat2, group = line_group)) +
    geom_point() +
    # Add text along the line
    geom_labelpath(
      aes(label = demcat2, hjust = hjust, vjust = vjust),
      boxcolor = "white",
      text_smoothing = 0,
      size = path_text_size,
      rich = TRUE
    ) +
    # Add a horizontal line at y = 0
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "gray", linetype = "dashed") +
    # Add the demcat_against data
    geom_richtext(
      data = demcat_against,
      aes(label = demcat, x = x, y = y),
      fill = "#BCD35F",
      color = "#BCD35F",
      text.colour = "black",
      hjust = 0.5, vjust = 0.5, inherit.aes = FALSE, size = demcat_text_size, angle = 0
    ) +
    scale_color_discrete_qualitative(palette = "Dark 3") +
    labs( x = "-log10(p value) cutoff", y = "Spearman correlation") +
    theme(legend.position = "none")
}


# Test the function
cor_series |>
  prepare_data_for_line_plot("normal2mci", "prev") |>
  # Add two columns for hjust and vjust using case_when based on
  # the demcat1 and demcat2
  mutate(hjust = case_when(
    # normal2incid category
    demcat2 == "normal2incid" & demcat1 == "normal2mci" ~ 0.1,
    demcat2 == "normal2incid" & demcat1 == "prev" ~ 0.1,
    # mci2incid category
    demcat2 == "mci2incid" & demcat1 == "normal2mci" ~ 0.5,
    demcat2 == "mci2incid" & demcat1 == "prev" ~ 0.5,
    # stable_mci category
    demcat2 == "stable_mci" & demcat1 == "normal2mci" ~ 0.9,
    demcat2 == "stable_mci" & demcat1 == "prev" ~ 0.9,
    TRUE ~ 0.5
  ),
  vjust = case_when(
    # normal2incid category
    demcat2 == "normal2incid" & demcat1 == "normal2mci" ~ 1.8,
    demcat2 == "normal2incid" & demcat1 == "prev" ~ -0.8,
    # mci2incid category
    demcat2 == "mci2incid" & demcat1 == "normal2mci" ~ 1,
    demcat2 == "mci2incid" & demcat1 == "prev" ~ 1.1,
    # stable_mci category
    demcat2 == "stable_mci" & demcat1 == "normal2mci" ~ 0.5,
    demcat2 == "stable_mci" & demcat1 == "prev" ~ 0.5,
    TRUE ~ 0.5
  )) |> 
  make_line_plot_with_text(path_text_size = 4, demcat_text_size = 8)

```


### normal2mci and prev

Make line plots for the correlation along p value cutoffs, color the line by the second category. Use "normal2mic" and "prev" for the first category and represent the second category by different line types.


```{r}
#| label: fig-normal2mci-vs-prev
#| fig.width: 10
#| fig.height: 6

demcat_base <- "normal2mci"
demcat_other <- "prev"

# Make a demcat tibble
demcat_against <- tibble(
  demcat = c(glue("<span style='font-size:6pt'> vs. </span> {demcat_base}"), glue("<span style='font-size:6pt'> vs. </span> {demcat_other}")),
  x = c(5, 5),
  y = c(-0.1, 0.1)
)

data_for_normal2mci_vs_prev_plot <-
  cor_series |>
  prepare_data_for_line_plot(demcat_base, demcat_other) |>
  # Add two columns for hjust and vjust using case_when based on
  # the demcat1 and demcat2
  mutate(hjust = case_when(
    # normal2incid category
    demcat2 == "normal2incid" & demcat1 == demcat_base ~ 0.1,
    demcat2 == "normal2incid" & demcat1 == demcat_other ~ 0.1,
    # mci2incid category
    demcat2 == "mci2incid" & demcat1 == demcat_base ~ 0.5,
    demcat2 == "mci2incid" & demcat1 == demcat_other ~ 0.5,
    # stable_mci category
    demcat2 == "stable_mci" & demcat1 == demcat_base ~ 0.9,
    demcat2 == "stable_mci" & demcat1 == demcat_other ~ 0.9,
    TRUE ~ 0.5
  ),
  vjust = case_when(
    # normal2incid category
    demcat2 == "normal2incid" & demcat1 == demcat_base ~ 1.8,
    demcat2 == "normal2incid" & demcat1 == demcat_other ~ -0.8,
    # mci2incid category
    demcat2 == "mci2incid" & demcat1 == demcat_base ~ 1,
    demcat2 == "mci2incid" & demcat1 == demcat_other ~ 1.1,
    # stable_mci category
    demcat2 == "stable_mci" & demcat1 == demcat_base ~ 0.5,
    demcat2 == "stable_mci" & demcat1 == demcat_other ~ 0.5,
    TRUE ~ 0.5
  ))


line_plot_ES_corr_main$normal2mci_vs_prev <-
  data_for_normal2mci_vs_prev_plot |> 
  make_line_plot_with_text(path_text_size = 3, demcat_text_size = 3)

line_plot_ES_corr_suppl$normal2mci_vs_prev <-
  data_for_normal2mci_vs_prev_plot |> 
  make_line_plot_with_text(path_text_size = 4, demcat_text_size = 6)

line_plot_ES_corr_suppl$normal2mci_vs_prev
```
